user.title: Create an Entity List
user.description: Create a new list entity. Choose Standard for a simple named list, or Alert for a list with new/active/cleared status tracking and notifications.

data_description.list_id: Optional. Leave blank to generate one automatically from the name.
data_description.max_size: Optional. Once the list holds this many items, adding a new one removes the oldest. Leave blank for no limit.
data_description.max_size_entity: Optional, and only if you'd rather set the cap from an input_number or counter entity than a fixed number here. If both this and the number above are set, this entity wins.

alert_targets.title: Notification targets
alert_targets.description: Choose up to two notify entities (for example your phone's companion app) to alert when a new item is created on this list.

reconfigure.title: Change list ID
reconfigure.description: Fix a typo in this list's ID without deleting and recreating it. Existing items carry over. Name, description, sort order, notify targets, and max size are edited via the Configure button instead.

error.too_many_targets: Choose at most two notify targets.
error.invalid_list_id: List ID must be lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only (no spaces).
error.max_size_conflict: Set either a fixed max size or an entity reference, not both.

abort.already_configured: A list with this ID already exists.

init.title: Edit list settings
init.description: The list ID and list type cannot be changed here — use Reconfigure for the list ID (list type can never be changed).

data_description.max_size: Optional. Once the list holds this many items, adding a new one removes the oldest. Leave blank for no limit.
data_description.max_size_entity: Optional, and only if you'd rather set the cap from an input_number or counter entity than a fixed number here. If both this and the number above are set, this entity wins.

error.too_many_targets: Choose at most two notify targets.
error.max_size_conflict: Set either a fixed max size or an entity reference, not both.

stale_notify_target.title: Notify target not found
stale_notify_target.description: The notify target `{target}` configured for the "{list_name}" list could not be found. Open the list's Configure options and update its notify targets.
